type.max_clipped_load_bearing_nodes.rationale: A headline, title, takeaway, lede, kicker, hero, or subline that exceeds its rendered client box has lost content. Browser scroll dimensions make this mechanically testable after font fallback and line breaking have happened.

skills/render/references/qa-gates.md: No content clipped at any edge

type.max_clipped_nodes.rationale: Any rendered text overflow is worth surfacing, but arbitrary micro-copy may be deliberately constrained. The audit reports every clipped node while only load-bearing roles block export.

gates.text-clipping: Load-bearing text fits inside its rendered client box without truncation.
